decision.justification: Selected 'mean' (an agent proposal) as the best of 11 backtested attempts, score 1.0. Series context: trend strength 0.9596 and seasonal strength 0.1792; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.501); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 7.752.
